body:
Both external review transfers completed successfully and their independent host/provenance checks passed. Primary grading continues within Phase4.6.

Additional bounded refutation checks: can these run on the VM? **Yes.** On a fresh unchanged14 pair/local synthetic WebDAV endpoint, verify (1) stranded-at-root content discovery and the actual content scan, (2) the installed cloud_sync_helper's conversion of stock-shaped missing CONTENT_REMOTE to the explicit root, (3) the installed timeout command's treatment of one owned sleep child, and (4) the actual 30-second opening-scan timeout reached by delaying only its second marker read through a QA PATH wrapper. Retain before/after hashes/pointers, command outputs, elapsed time, installed script hashes and cleanup. No physical device, personal cloud or extra provider call.

The original ten-case proof was repeated with full per-case config restoration after an invalid-assignment fixture survived the previous reset; the failed attempt remains preserved. Zero experiment-run status means complete observations, not a declaration that the product passed every challenge. New owner for these four checks: `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-p4-reviewer-coverage-01`; launch follows actual cleanup of reviewer-leads03.
